records.text: Leslie Solis reported that the case accusing former Caldwell football coach Kip Crofts of sexual abuse of a child under 16 was dismissed before trial because newly discovered information prevented prosecutors from establishing intent.
records.speaker: Leslie Solis

appearances.snippet: After months of court hearings and with trial set to begin next week, the criminal case against former high school football coach Kip Crofts has been dismissed. ... I'm your Caldwell neighborhood reporter Leslie Solis and I was the only reporter in the courtroom as prosecutors informed the judge that newly discovered information prevents them from proceeding with a charge of sexual abuse of a child under 16. ... What had been headed towards a jury trial instead came to a halt inside a Canyon County courtroom on Tuesday. ... The case centered on allegations that Crofts exposed himself while watching explicit material in a Caldwell High School classroom with a 14-year-old student. ... present. Prosecutors told the court that information uncovered during final trial preparation changed their ability to establish intent, a required part of the felony charge.
